verses.original: Τότε προσέρχονται τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων Φαρισαῖοι καὶ γραμματεῖς λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: Tote proserchontai tō Iēsou apo Hierosolymōn Pharisaioi kai grammateis legontes
verses.literal: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked
verses.literalPt: Então, vieram de Jerusalém a Jesus alguns fariseus e escribas e perguntaram-lhe:

verses.original: Διὰ τί οἱ μαθηταί σου παραβαίνουσιν τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων οὐ γὰρ νίπτονται τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ὅταν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν
verses.transliteration: Dia ti hoi mathētai sou parabainousin tēn paradosin tōn presbyterōn ou gar niptontai tas cheiras autōn hotan arton esthiōsin
verses.literal: Why do . . . Your disciples break the tradition of the elders They do not wash their hands before they eat . . .
verses.literalPt: Por que transgridem os teus discípulos a tradição dos anciãos? Pois não lavam as mãos quando comem pão.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Διὰ τί καὶ ὑμεῖς παραβαίνετε τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen autois Dia ti kai hymeis parabainete tēn entolēn tou Theou dia tēn paradosin hymōn
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . And why . . . do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes: E vós, por que transgredis o mandamento de Deus por causa da vossa tradição?

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ Θεὸς εἶπεν Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καί Ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω
verses.transliteration: ho gar Theos eipen Tima ton patera kai tēn mētera kai Ho kakologōn patera ē mētera thanatō teleutatō
verses.literal: For God said Honor your father and mother and Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus disse: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe; e também: Quem maldisser a seu pai ou a sua mãe, seja morto; mas vós ensinais:

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ λέγετε Ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί Δῶρον ὃ ἐὰν ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὠφεληθῇς
verses.transliteration: hymeis de legete Hos an eipē tō patri ē tē mētri Dōron ho ean ex emou ōphelēthēs
verses.literal: But you say that if anyone . . . says to his father or mother Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God
verses.literalPt: Se alguém disser a seu pai ou a sua mãe: Aquilo que eu te poderia dar já ofereci a Deus

verses.original: οὐ μὴ τιμήσει τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ ἢ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἠκυρώσατε τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ διὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ou mē timēsei ton patera autou ē tēn mētera autou kai ēkyrōsate ton logon tou Theou dia tēn paradosin hymōn
verses.literal: he need not honor his father or - mother with it Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition
verses.literalPt: o tal não precisará mais honrar a seu pai, nem a sua mãe. Assim, invalidais a palavra de Deus por causa da vossa tradição.

verses.original: ὑποκριταί καλῶς ἐπροφήτευσεν περὶ ὑμῶν Ἠσαΐας λέγων
verses.transliteration: hypokritai kalōs eprophēteusen peri hymōn Ēsaias legōn
verses.literal: You hypocrites Isaiah prophesied correctly about you
verses.literalPt: Hipócritas, bem profetizou de vós Isaías:

verses.original: Ὁ λαὸς οὗτος τοῖς χείλεσίν με τιμᾷ Ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho laos houtos tois cheilesin me tima Hē de kardia autōn porrō apechei ap’ emou
verses.literal: These people honor Me with their lips but their hearts are far . . . from Me
verses.literalPt: Este povo honra-me com os lábios, mas o seu coração está longe de mim;

verses.original: Μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με Διδάσκοντες διδασκαλίας ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Matēn de sebontai me Didaskontes didaskalias entalmata anthrōpōn
verses.literal: They worship Me in vain they teach as doctrine the precepts of men
verses.literalPt: Adoram-me, porém, em vão, ensinando doutrinas que são preceitos de homens.

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀκούετε καὶ συνίετε
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos ton ochlon eipen autois Akouete kai syniete
verses.literal: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said Listen and understand
verses.literalPt: Chamando a si a multidão, disse-lhe: Ouvi e entendei:

verses.original: οὐ τὸ εἰσερχόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἀλλὰ τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦτο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: ou to eiserchomenon eis to stoma koinoi ton anthrōpon alla to ekporeuomenon ek tou stomatos touto koinoi ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: A man is not defiled . . . by what enters . . . his mouth but - - by what comes out of it
verses.literalPt: Não é o que entra pela boca o que contamina o homem, mas o que sai da boca, é isso o que o contamina.

verses.original: Τότε προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Οἶδας ὅτι οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον ἐσκανδαλίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Tote proselthontes hoi mathētai legousin autō Oidas hoti hoi Pharisaioi akousantes ton logon eskandalisthēsan
verses.literal: Then the disciples came to Him and said Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this
verses.literalPt: Então, os discípulos, aproximando-se de Jesus, perguntaram-lhe: Sabes que os fariseus, ouvindo o que disseste, ficaram escandalizados?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Πᾶσα φυτεία ἣν οὐκ ἐφύτευσεν ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ἐκριζωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Pasa phyteia hēn ouk ephyteusen ho Patēr mou ho ouranios ekrizōthēsetai
verses.literal: But Jesus replied Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots
verses.literalPt: Mas ele respondeu: Toda planta que meu Pai celestial não plantou será arrancada pela raiz.

verses.original: ἄφετε αὐτούς τυφλοί εἰσιν ὁδηγοί τυφλῶν τυφλὸς δὲ τυφλὸν ἐὰν ὁδηγῇ ἀμφότεροι εἰς βόθυνον πεσοῦνται
verses.transliteration: aphete autous typhloi eisin hodēgoi typhlōn typhlos de typhlon ean hodēgē amphoteroi eis bothynon pesountai
verses.literal: Disregard them They are blind guides - If a blind man leads a blind man both will fall into a pit
verses.literalPt: Deixai-os; são cegos, guias de cegos. Se um cego guiar outro cego, cairão ambos no barranco.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Φράσον ἡμῖν τὴν παραβολήν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Petros eipen autō Phrason hēmin tēn parabolēn tautēn
verses.literal: Peter said . . . to Him Explain this parable to us
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Explica-nos a parábola.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἀκμὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀσύνετοί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Akmēn kai hymeis asynetoi este
verses.literal: Do you still not understand - Jesus asked
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Também vós não entendeis ainda?

verses.original: οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸ στόμα εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν χωρεῖ καὶ εἰς ἀφεδρῶνα ἐκβάλλεται
verses.transliteration: ou noeite hoti pan to eisporeuomenon eis to stoma eis tēn koilian chōrei kai eis aphedrōna ekballetai
verses.literal: Do you not yet realize that whatever enters . . . the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Não sabeis que tudo o que entra pela boca desce ao ventre e é lançado em lugar escuso?

verses.original: τὰ δὲ ἐκπορευόμενα ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ἐκ τῆς καρδίας ἐξέρχεται κἀκεῖνα κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: ta de ekporeuomena ek tou stomatos ek tēs kardias exerchetai kakeina koinoi ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart and these things defile a man
verses.literalPt: Mas tudo o que sai da boca vem do coração, e isso contamina o homem.

verses.original: ἐκ γὰρ τῆς καρδίας ἐξέρχονται διαλογισμοὶ πονηροί φόνοι μοιχεῖαι πορνεῖαι κλοπαί ψευδομαρτυρίαι βλασφημίαι
verses.transliteration: ek gar tēs kardias exerchontai dialogismoi ponēroi phonoi moicheiai porneiai klopai pseudomartyriai blasphēmiai
verses.literal: For out of the heart come evil thoughts murder adultery sexual immorality theft false testimony and slander
verses.literalPt: Pois do coração procedem maus pensamentos, homicídios, adultérios, fornicações, furtos, falsos testemunhos, blasfêmias.

verses.original: ταῦτά ἐστιν τὰ κοινοῦντα τὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸ δὲ ἀνίπτοις χερσὶν φαγεῖν οὐ κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: tauta estin ta koinounta ton anthrōpon to de aniptois chersin phagein ou koinoi ton anthrōpon
verses.literal: These are what defile a man but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him
verses.literalPt: Estas coisas são as que contaminam o homem; porém o comer sem lavar as mãos não o contamina.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Τύρου καὶ Σιδῶνος
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn ekeithen ho Iēsous anechōrēsen eis ta merē Tyrou kai Sidōnos
verses.literal: Leaving that place Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon
verses.literalPt: Tendo saído Jesus dali, retirou-se para os lados de Tiro e de Sidom.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ Χαναναία ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων ἐκείνων ἐξελθοῦσα ἔκραζεν λέγουσα Ἐλέησόν με Κύριε υἱὸς Δαυίδ ἡ θυγάτηρ μου κακῶς δαιμονίζεται
verses.transliteration: kai idou gynē Chananaia apo tōn horiōn ekeinōn exelthousa ekrazen legousa Eleēson me Kyrie huios Dauid hē thygatēr mou kakōs daimonizetai
verses.literal: And . . . a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him crying out Lord Son of David have mercy on me My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon
verses.literalPt: Uma mulher cananeia, que tinha vindo daquelas regiões, clamava: Senhor, filho de Davi, tem compaixão de mim! Minha filha está horrivelmente endemoninhada.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῇ λόγον καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἠρώτουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Ἀπόλυσον αὐτήν ὅτι κράζει ὄπισθεν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de ouk apekrithē autē logon kai proselthontes hoi mathētai autou ērōtoun auton legontes Apolyson autēn hoti krazei opisthen hēmōn
verses.literal: But Jesus did not answer a word So His disciples came and urged Him Send her away . . . for she keeps crying out after us
verses.literalPt: Todavia, ele não lhe respondeu palavra. Chegando seus discípulos, rogaram-lhe: Despede-a, porque vem clamando atrás de nós.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἀπεστάλην εἰ μὴ εἰς τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἀπολωλότα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ouk apestalēn ei mē eis ta probata ta apolōlota oikou Israēl
verses.literal: He answered . . . I was sent only . . . to the lost sheep of the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus respondeu: Não fui enviado senão às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ ἐλθοῦσα προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγουσα Κύριε βοήθει μοι
verses.transliteration: Hē de elthousa prosekynei autō legousa Kyrie boēthei moi
verses.literal: The woman came and knelt before Him Lord help me she said
verses.literalPt: Contudo, ela, aproximando-se, o adorou, dizendo: Senhor, socorre-me!

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐκ ἔστιν καλὸν λαβεῖν τὸν ἄρτον τῶν τέκνων καὶ βαλεῖν τοῖς κυναρίοις
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ouk estin kalon labein ton arton tōn teknōn kai balein tois kynariois
verses.literal: But Jesus replied It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs
verses.literalPt: Ele respondeu: Não é bom tomar o pão dos filhos e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Ναί κύριε καὶ γὰρ τὰ κυνάρια ἐσθίει ἀπὸ τῶν ψιχίων τῶν πιπτόντων ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē de eipen Nai kyrie kai gar ta kynaria esthiei apo tōn psichiōn tōn piptontōn apo tēs trapezēs tōn kyriōn autōn
verses.literal: Yes Lord - she said even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table
verses.literalPt: Ela, porém, replicou: Assim é, Senhor; mas até os cachorrinhos comem das migalhas que caem da mesa de seus donos.

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῇ Ὦ γύναι μεγάλη σου ἡ πίστις γενηθήτω σοι ὡς θέλεις καὶ ἰάθη ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτῆς ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης
verses.transliteration: Tote apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autē Ō gynai megalē sou hē pistis genēthētō soi hōs theleis kai iathē hē thygatēr autēs apo tēs hōras ekeinēs
verses.literal: O woman - Jesus answered . . . . . . your faith is great Let it be done for you as you desire And her daughter was healed from that very hour
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse Jesus: Ó mulher, grande é a tua fé! Faça-se contigo como queres. E desde aquela hora sua filha ficou sã.

verses.original: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἀναβὰς εἰς τὸ ὄρος ἐκάθητο ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai metabas ekeithen ho Iēsous ēlthen para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias kai anabas eis to oros ekathēto ekei
verses.literal: Moving on from there Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee Then He went up on a mountain and sat down
verses.literalPt: Partiu Jesus daquele lugar e voltou ao mar da Galileia; e, tendo subido ao monte, ali se assentou.

verses.original: καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἔχοντες μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν χωλούς κυλλούς τυφλούς κωφούς καὶ ἑτέρους πολλούς καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτοὺς παρὰ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai prosēlthon autō ochloi polloi echontes meth’ heautōn chōlous kyllous typhlous kōphous kai heterous pollous kai erripsan autous para tous podas autou kai etherapeusen autous
verses.literal: Large crowds came to Him bringing . . . . . . the lame the blind the crippled the mute and many others and laid them at His feet and He healed them
verses.literalPt: Veio a ele uma grande multidão, trazendo consigo coxos, aleijados, cegos, mudos e outros muitos, e puseram-lhos aos pés; ele os curou,

verses.original: ὥστε τὸν ὄχλον θαυμάσαι βλέποντας κωφοὺς λαλοῦντας κυλλοὺς ὑγιεῖς καὶ χωλοὺς περιπατοῦντας καὶ τυφλοὺς βλέποντας καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν Θεὸν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: hōste ton ochlon thaumasai blepontas kōphous lalountas kyllous hygieis kai chōlous peripatountas kai typhlous blepontas kai edoxasan ton Theon Israēl
verses.literal: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking the crippled restored the lame walking and the blind seeing And they glorified the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: de modo que a multidão se maravilhou, ao ver mudos falar, aleijados ficar sãos, coxos andar, cegos ver; e glorificaram ao Deus de Israel.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν Σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον ὅτι ἤδη ἡμέραι τρεῖς προσμένουσίν μοι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν τί φάγωσιν καὶ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτοὺς νήστεις οὐ θέλω μή‿ ποτε ἐκλυθῶσιν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous proskalesamenos tous mathētas autou eipen Splanchnizomai epi ton ochlon hoti ēdē hēmerai treis prosmenousin moi kai ouk echousin ti phagōsin kai apolysai autous nēsteis ou thelō mē pote eklythōsin en tē hodō
verses.literal: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said I have compassion for this crowd because they have already been . . . with Me three days and have nothing to eat I do not want to send them away . . . hungry or they may faint along the way
verses.literalPt: Chamando Jesus a seus discípulos, disse: Tenho compaixão deste povo, porque há três dias que estão sempre comigo e nada têm o que comer. Não quero despedi-los em jejum, para que não desfaleçam no caminho.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί Πόθεν ἡμῖν ἐν ἐρημίᾳ ἄρτοι τοσοῦτοι ὥστε χορτάσαι ὄχλον τοσοῦτον
verses.transliteration: Kai legousin autō hoi mathētai Pothen hēmin en erēmia artoi tosoutoi hōste chortasai ochlon tosouton
verses.literal: The disciples replied Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe os discípulos: Onde encontraremos neste deserto tantos pães para fartar tão grande multidão?

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πόσους ἄρτους ἔχετε Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἑπτά καὶ ὀλίγα ἰχθύδια
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois ho Iēsous Posous artous echete Hoi de eipan Hepta kai oliga ichthydia
verses.literal: How many loaves do you have - Jesus asked Seven - they replied and a few small fish
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhes Jesus: Quantos pães tendes? Responderam: Sete e alguns peixinhos.

verses.original: Καὶ παραγγείλας τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Kai parangeilas tō ochlō anapesein epi tēn gēn
verses.literal: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground
verses.literalPt: Tendo mandado ao povo que se assentasse no chão,

verses.original: ἔλαβεν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς ἰχθύας καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις
verses.transliteration: elaben tous hepta artous kai tous ichthyas kai eucharistēsas eklasen kai edidou tois mathētais hoi de mathētai tois ochlois
verses.literal: Taking the seven loaves and the fish He gave thanks and broke them Then He gave them to the disciples and the disciples gave them to the people
verses.literalPt: tomou os sete pães e os peixes, e, dando graças, partiu-os, e entregou aos discípulos, e os discípulos entregaram-nos ao povo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν καὶ τὸ περισσεῦον τῶν κλασμάτων ἦραν ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας πλήρεις
verses.transliteration: Kai ephagon pantes kai echortasthēsan kai to perisseuon tōn klasmatōn ēran hepta spyridas plēreis
verses.literal: They all ate and were satisfied and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls . . . of broken pieces that were left over
verses.literalPt: Todos comeram e se fartaram; e do que sobejou levantaram sete alcofas cheias de pedaços.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐσθίοντες ἦσαν τετρακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες χωρὶς γυναικῶν καὶ παιδίων
verses.transliteration: hoi de esthiontes ēsan tetrakischilioi andres chōris gynaikōn kai paidiōn
verses.literal: A total of . . . four thousand men were fed besides women and children
verses.literalPt: Ora, os que comeram foram quatro mil homens, além de mulheres e crianças.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπολύσας τοὺς ὄχλους ἐνέβη εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια Μαγαδάν
verses.transliteration: Kai apolysas tous ochlous enebē eis to ploion kai ēlthen eis ta horia Magadan
verses.literal: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds He got into . . . the boat and went to the region of Magadan
verses.literalPt: Despedido o povo, Jesus entrou na barca e foi para os confins de Magadã.
